title: Industry Context Profile v1
description: Reusable global industry and business context. Field names are English; human-readable values use identity.language. Collections are always arrays. Unknown facts use null or empty collections and must never be fabricated. This profile must not contain current dates, current hot trends, or site-specific Topics, Keywords, Articles, GSC, or SEO Audit state.
$comment: Future generated content uses context_links entries shaped as {type: audience|customer_need|offering|demand_driver|seasonality|content_universe, ref: stable-id}. A candidate with zero valid context_links is invalid. Never store chain-of-thought.
x-agent-purpose: Build a full, stable map of the industry and business world for reusable downstream context. Do not generate current attention opportunities, current trends, viral or breakout ideas, article titles, or ready-made content plans.
x-generation-rules: Generate a comprehensive Core profile. Use the model's full available capability and do not save room for separate Discovery or Breakout work.

Do not intentionally cap useful collections at 3-5 items. Where meaningful, generate enough distinct audiences, offerings, adjacent products, substitutes, jobs-to-be-done, pain points, questions, decision factors, demand drivers, seasonal events, content territories, and search modifiers to represent the industry well.
Prefer breadth of distinct useful facts over verbose descriptions. Do not add duplicate near-synonyms merely to increase count.

Use only stable or durable knowledge. Do not include current_date, current_month, today's trends, current viral topics, current news, current social buzz, or site-specific Topics, Keywords, Articles, GSC, or SEO Audit state.

Do not fabricate factual-looking prices, typical order values, MOQ, sales cycles, purchase frequency, or geography-specific facts. Use null or empty arrays when evidence or input does not support a value.

When identity.language is vi, all human-readable values must primarily be Vietnamese. English is reference metadata, not a writing style. Use English only for useful acronyms, industry-standard terms, or hard-to-translate technology/product terms, and include a Vietnamese explanation where useful, for example MOQ (số lượng đặt hàng tối thiểu), OEM/ODM (sản xuất theo thiết kế hoặc thương hiệu đặt hàng), and EDC (các vật dụng thường mang theo hằng ngày). Do not write complete sections in English. Do not write complete names, descriptions, sentences, or headings in English. Other languages retain normal locale-aware behavior.

industry_taxonomy.description: Allows discovery to move outward from the exact product while remaining inside the business industry.

industry_keywords.description: Concise reusable SEO seed keywords and entity vocabulary, not full queries. Normally target 1-4 words and strongly prefer 5 words or fewer. Exceed 5 words only when the meaning genuinely cannot be preserved in a shorter phrase. Avoid sentence-like keywords and avoid stuffing audience, location, price, use case, and attributes into one phrase. Prefer the shortest phrase that preserves clear search intent.

offerings.description: Product/service families and adjacent commercial space, not a product database.

questions.description: Stable customer questions. Full natural-language questions are allowed here and are not constrained by the concise industry keyword preference.

trend_sensitivity.description: Describes durable sensitivity to trends; never stores current viral products, people, memes, or other hot trends.

content_universe.description: Stable Core map of the industry's reusable topic territories and knowledge areas. It is not a collection of article titles, current opportunities, viral topics, current trends, Discovery/Attention output, Breakout output, content briefs, or ready-made content plans.
content_universe.x-agent-purpose: Defines the durable, business-grounded knowledge map for future planning.
x-generation-rules: Do not copy a site's current Topics.
Generate broad topic territories and knowledge areas, never numbered headlines, clickbait titles, final SEO titles, full article ideas, or content briefs.
Favor breadth and many meaningful distinct territories over long descriptions; do not hard-limit collections to 3-5 entries.

core_topics.description: Territories directly central to the industry's products, services, and expertise.

adjacent_topics.description: Nearby industries, products, use cases, and customer needs with durable business relevance.

lifestyle_topics.description: Durable lifestyle areas naturally connected to the audiences or use cases.

educational_topics.description: Stable knowledge and learning territories relevant to the industry.

commercial_topics.description: Durable buying, comparison, evaluation, and selection territories.

business_topics.description: B2B, procurement, operations, manufacturing, distribution, and branding territories where relevant.

search_behavior.description: Describes search space; it must not instruct runtime to mechanically concatenate keyword strings.

query_patterns.description: Realistic examples of how users may express searches. Query patterns may be longer than concise industry keywords and must never be mechanically treated as primary keyword candidates.

relevance_rule.description: Stable business-relevance rule for this Core Industry Context.
